🎥🎬: Kingsman: The Golden Circle (2017)

After a devastating attack destroys the Kingsman headquarters, Eggsy and Merlin find themselves among the last surviving members of Britain’s elite secret intelligence organization. Their search for answers leads them to the Statesman, a secret American spy agency whose agents operate behind the cover of a whiskey distillery.

The two organizations must join forces to stop Poppy Adams, a ruthless drug lord who controls a powerful criminal empire hidden in the jungle. After poisoning millions of people around the world, Poppy threatens to withhold the antidote unless the United States ends its war on drugs, forcing the spies into a desperate race against time.

With explosive action, elaborate gadgets, unexpected betrayals, and dangerous missions, Eggsy and his allies must overcome their differences to save countless lives. But defeating Poppy will require more than brilliant espionage—it will demand courage, sacrifice, and a willingness to risk everything.

source_details.synopsis: Kingsman: The Golden Circle is a 2017 spy action comedy film directed by Matthew Vaughn and written by Jane Goldman and Vaughn. Based on the Kingsman comic series, it is the sequel to Kingsman: The Secret Service (2014) and is the second installment in the Kingsman franchise. Its ensemble cast includes Colin Firth, Julianne Moore, Taron Egerton, Mark Strong, Halle Berry, Elton John, Channing Tatum, and Jeff Bridges. In the film, Kingsman team up with their American counterpart, Statesman, to pursue Poppy Adams (Moore) and her drug cartel, "The Golden Circle".
